messages.text: Quick question for the floor: I've got a member asking why a mobile deposit from this morning is still on hold. It's {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0012}}, checking {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00024}}. Anyone seen the hold reason codes behave oddly today?
What's the hold reason showing on the item? If it says new-deposit or exception hold, that's usually the standard Reg CC next-day schedule. If it's a manual review flag, that's different.
It says exception hold, $2,400 check. Member has been with us since 2021 so I don't think it's a new-account thing. Risk rating is medium, if that matters.
FYI I had two mobile deposit holds this morning too, both over $2,000. Starting to wonder if the threshold for auto-hold got tightened. Anyone know?

I don't think the threshold changed. Reg CC says large deposits over $5,525 can get an exception hold, but we also do our own review on mobile items when the image quality score is low. Could be blurry endorsements.
Nichole, check whether the check image has a restrictive endorsement or missing 'for mobile deposit only' line. That trips the exception hold more than anything lately.
Good call Catherine. The endorsement is there but the image is a little dark. So probably a quality flag, not a risk thing. Should I release it or send it to review?
Don't release it yourself. Send it to the deposit review queue and note it in MemberCRM. If the check is clean, ops will clear it today. Tell the member to expect a decision by end of day.
Will do, thanks Paul. I'll call {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0012}} at {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0012}} once it's in the queue and explain the delay so they aren't surprised.
Update on mine: both were low image quality flags, same as Nichole's. Looks like a few members are snapping photos in poor light. Might be worth a quick tip in the next member newsletter.
Good idea Zachary. Joanna, can you draft two lines on mobile deposit photo tips, flat surface, good light, all four corners visible? We'll get it to marketing this week.
On it. I'll have a draft in this thread by Wednesday.
